text: First bounded CLI pairing agreed in Fray23: codex-temporal publishes MappingExchangeBuild.exportWorkspace(input, ArtifactId, output) with exact input/policy/record/manifest receipt; codex-m1 owns command dispatch, CLI tests and docs in isolated solo/public-cli from helper6a310fe3. This component does not close the ordinary-file study workflow ticket.
